# The Renewables Obligation (Scotland) Order 2009, section 22C

> Text as at 2026-04-01.

## 22C. Electricity generated by certain types of biomass generating station[^key-3985cb3837167c5251b1ee38b595e461]

(1) This article applies to a generating station which—

- (a) is first commissioned after 31st March 2014;
- (b) has a total installed capacity of more than 15 megawatts;
- (c) generates electricity from relevant biomass.

(2) No SROCs are to be issued in respect of any electricity generated in any month by a generating station to which this article applies—

- (a)[^key-892c60b61a81d7b24733928eaebf3f61] unless the generating station was accredited under CHPQA when first commissioned and is accredited under CHPQA during the relevant month;
- (b) if the generating station has not been a qualifying combined heat and power generating[^key-b8d762a067d7f689b3343544858868d4] station during the whole or part of 5 or more obligation periods.

(3) In this article “relevant biomass” means biomass which is composed wholly or partly from wood which is not an energy crop and “[^key-0861940caa86d5bcdda3c3e4d8952385]CHPQA” in relation to accreditation obtained before 1st April 2014 has the meaning given by article 2 before that date and in relation to accreditation obtained on or after 1st April 2014 and before 1st January 2017 has the meaning given by article 2 on 1st April 2014[^key-8f4af49e1eb10421cfa5957ea929848c].
